title: Opening your first day
target: A short, factual checklist for the first time you open the shop, based only on things the game's own files establish.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A new save with the starting shop
At least one shelf you can reach
Stock available in the storage room

steps.do: Put stock on a shelf before you open the door.
steps.because: the game only sells what the shelf holds and it refills a slot that is empty (ProductRestockLoop, SpawnProductOnEmptyShelf)

steps.do: Stand at the checkout when the first customers arrive.
steps.because: paying customers go through explicit checkout and payment steps (StartCashierCheckout, FinishCheckout)

steps.do: Spend the first takings on products you can already order.
steps.because: a product can require a store level before it becomes available (RequiredStoreLevel)

commonMistakes: Opening with empty shelves: a shelf sells only what you put on it.
Trying to order a product that the shop level has not unlocked yet.
Leaving the checkout unattended while a queue forms.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
